name: iHRIS 4 on FHIR
documentation: How the derived subgraph src/ihris-4-on-fhir is built: generate FSH from the data dictionary and terminology, build with SUSHI, validate, and map to iHRIS 5. Documented 2026-09-23; SUSHI runs later (owner). Logical models wait for folio-assistant cz17, StructureMaps wait for the logical models, and render waits for the lightweight IG render pipeline. Operating skill: ihris-4-on-fhir.

lanes.name: Agent
lanes.documentation: Generates FSH. It never edits generated FSH or SUSHI output; it changes the inputs or the generator.

lanes.name: Build pipeline
lanes.documentation: Runs SUSHI and the validators. A dirty SUSHI run blocks the commit.

lanes.name: Owner
lanes.documentation: Unblocks phases and accepts the mapping. Uncertain mappings arrive as proposals, which only the owner moves.

nodes.name: Generate terminology FSH
nodes.documentation: F2. CodeSystems, ValueSets and ConceptMaps from src/ihris-dak/terminology inputs.

nodes.name: Generate logical models
nodes.documentation: F3. One logical model per form class, in the form smart-base's DAK model settles on.

nodes.name: Generate StructureMaps to iHRIS 5
nodes.documentation: F4. Maps to all three iHRIS 5 IGs, pinned to a commit. Uncertain matches become proposals.

nodes.name: SUSHI build (must be clean)
nodes.documentation: Tool ihris-sushi. Zero errors are required, and warnings are reported.

nodes.name: Validate
nodes.documentation: Tool ihris-validate-kg: FHIR structure, content-equality with the retired JSON (D8), and codes that resolve.

nodes.name: Accept mappings and phase
nodes.noSkill: The owner's decision on proposals and on unblocking the next phase.

nodes.name: Built; render waits for the pipeline
